title: From the chart to your signals
intro_say: MarketNavi. | From the chart to your signals.
outro_say: That's the Charts series. | The chart shows it; your Sets test it.

steps.screen: A card: chart tools that are also signals
steps.say: Many of the chart's tools are also signals. | Chart shapes, Sonar markers, fair value gaps, anchored VWAP and the volume profile. | So you can scan for them, build funnels from them, and test them.

steps.screen: The signal families in Signal Sets
steps.say: Open Signal Sets. | The new family, Levels made by trading, holds fair value gaps, anchored VWAP and the volume profile. | Chart shapes and Sonar markers have their own families.

steps.screen: Choosing the signal and its timeframe
steps.say: Pick the signal on the card, and the candle size it reads. | Each one has settings too, such as where the VWAP starts: the last swing low or high, or the start of the week, month or year.
We'll add fair value gaps and anchored VWAP, on four-hour candles.
Now the lines. | An up gap was tested in the last three candles: price dipped into a gap and held. | And the close is above the VWAP from the last swing low.
Chart shapes work the same way. | A double bottom confirmed, or a golden cross in the last five candles, can be a line in any Set.

steps.screen: A card: where to use it
steps.say: Now scan your assets with it in Prism, use it as a funnel stage, or show it as colour bands on the chart. | And Soundings checks these readings too, on years the search never saw.
